rows.note: Use 零 as the all-purpose word for zero, including the digit 0.

example.english: The first character in the code is nought.
example.jyutping: go3 mat6 maa5 dai6 jat1 go3 zi6 hai6 ling4

rows.note: Use 零分 specifically when a game or test score is no points.

example.english: I got nought marks in this quiz.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ci3 siu2 caak1 lo2 zo2 ling4 fan1
